title.zh-CN: 千禧街头服饰移动落地页

description.zh-CN: 生成一张海报式 9:16 移动端街头服饰品牌落地页，融合人物主视觉、夸张字标、贴纸拼贴、商品文案和购买按钮。
description.en-US: Design a mobile streetwear landing page with turn-of-the-millennium styling.

zh-CN.prompt:
创建一张 9:16 竖版、移动端优先的街头服饰品牌落地页，整体像一张可直接使用的全屏品牌海报。

品牌名为“{brandName}”，主口号为“{headline}”，系列名称为“{collectionName}”。背景使用深皇家蓝到藏蓝的竖向渐变，叠加轻微胶片颗粒与复古屏幕暖色。顶部放置小号全大写口号；其下是巨大、略微错位的粗厚衬线字标，使用明亮金盏花黄、深黄橙色立体阴影和少量金属高光。

画面中央是一位穿着品牌主打服装的年轻模特胸像，姿态松弛、自信，手持一个与系列相关的小道具。人物使用柔和蓝色轮廓光和自然暖肤色。服装胸前放置原创、无品牌联想的手绘角色图形。

在人物周围加入三枚不规则星形贴纸：产品细节特写、原创角色图形和“NEW DROP”短标签。贴纸带白色裁切边、轻微旋转、胶带角和柔和投影，形成真实 DIY 拼贴感。

底部依次排布：短标题、3 至 4 行品牌介绍、醒目的 `{ctaText}` 按钮、极细品牌信息条。确保文字层级清楚、按钮可辨识、人物不遮挡主要文案。配色锁定为深蓝、金盏花黄、奶油白、炭黑和一个高饱和点缀色。整体呈现千禧年滑板与冲浪街头文化、复古丝网印刷和高完成度电商视觉，不出现真实品牌 Logo 或现成卡通角色。

en-US.prompt:
Create a vertical 9:16 mobile-first streetwear-brand landing page that reads as a finished full-screen brand poster.

Use "{brandName}" as the brand, "{headline}" as the main slogan, and "{collectionName}" as the collection name. The background has a vertical deep royal-blue-to-navy gradient, subtle film grain, and a warm vintage-screen cast. Place a small uppercase slogan at the top, followed by a huge, slightly misregistered heavy serif wordmark in bright marigold yellow, with deep yellow-orange dimensional shadows and a few metallic highlights.

At the center, show a young model from the chest up wearing the brand's featured clothing, relaxed and confident, holding a small prop related to the collection. Use soft blue rim light and natural warm skin tones. Place an original hand-drawn character graphic on the garment's chest, without associations to existing brands.

Add three irregular star-shaped stickers around the model: a close-up of a product detail, an original character graphic, and a short "NEW DROP" label. Give the stickers white die-cut borders, slight rotation, taped corners, and soft shadows for an authentic DIY collage.

At the bottom, arrange a short headline, three to four lines of brand introduction, a prominent `{ctaText}` button, and a very fine brand-information strip. Keep text hierarchy clear, the button identifiable, and the model away from essential copy. Limit the palette to deep blue, marigold yellow, cream white, charcoal, and one saturated accent. Evoke Y2K skate/surf street culture, vintage screen printing, and polished e-commerce visuals, without real brand logos or existing cartoon characters.
